title: Bunker: Browser-based Party Game
summary: A fast, browser-based real-time party game inspired by the popular “Bunker” format. Players receive survival characters with hidden attributes and must convince others why they deserve a spot in the bunker during escalating disaster rounds.
description: This project is a web adaptation of the “Bunker” party game that I personally enjoy. I built it as a lightweight, real-time multiplayer experience playable directly in the browser. The main goal was to reproduce the original game mechanics online while exploring micro-backend development in Java for the first time using Spark. I also focused heavily on engineering practices by integrating SonarCloud for automated code quality analysis, adding JaCoCo for test coverage reporting, and using Jib for streamlined Docker image builds. Additional tooling such as the Spotify formatting/check plugin helped enforce consistent code style. Real-time gameplay is powered by WebSockets to keep all players synchronized with minimal latency, without requiring authentication or a persistent database.
details: Real-time: **WebSocket**-based state synchronization for multiplayer sessions
Code quality: **SonarCloud** integration for static analysis and quality gates
Containerization: **Docker** image builds using **Jib** (no Dockerfile needed)
Code style: **Spotify fmt/check** plugin for consistent formatting and validation
No database: Rooms and game sessions stored in **memory**
Zero auth: Players join instantly by entering a name
Bonus: During coding I learned that it's a great game to play with friends, and we still do it from time to time
details_md:
* **Backend**: **Spark Java** micro-backend + **WebSockets** (first experience)
* **Frontend**: **Vanilla JS** + **Tailwind CSS**
* **Real-time**: **WebSocket**-based state synchronization for multiplayer sessions
* **Code quality**: **SonarCloud** integration for static analysis and quality gates
* **Test coverage**: **JaCoCo** reports published into **SonarCloud**
* **Containerization**: **Docker** image builds using **Jib** (no Dockerfile needed)
* **Code style**: **Spotify fmt/check** plugin for consistent formatting and validation
* **No database**: Rooms and game sessions stored in **memory**
* **Zero auth**: Players join instantly by entering a name
